key.name: hover-delay-ms
key.description: Delay before the preview popup appears after the pointer enters a dock icon.

key.name: preview-layout
key.description: Whether previews are arranged in a vertical stack or horizontal strip.

key.name: preview-width
key.description: Width of each preview thumbnail in pixels.

key.name: preview-height
key.description: Height of each preview thumbnail in pixels.

key.name: title-overflow-mode
key.description: Whether long window titles are truncated with ellipsis or wrapped to the next line.

key.name: show-close-button
key.description: Whether each hover preview shows a close button for closing the corresponding window.

key.name: close-button-position
key.description: Whether the preview close button is shown on the left or right side of the preview card.
